//// open tag and its close tag. Where scanBlocks splits a paragraph micromark reads as one (a blockquote's lazy continuation, a footnote definition's text, a tab-indented line) or the close-tag regex ignores an escape (\), --write joins inside the element and exits 0: '> Quote 
line one
line two
' becomes 'line one line two
'; '[^1]: Run 
…' likewise; '> Run make
build
test first.' and 'Use a \ b
c here.' likewise. Fix in the guard: keep text values exact between a VERBATIM_OPEN html sibling and its close tag.
